sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:48174
Court No. - 16

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1963 of 2022
Applicant :- Ram Sumer Pandey
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Dhirendra Kumar Mishra,Mukesh Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dharmendra Kumar Tripathi,Suresh Chandra Srivastava,V
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Dhirendra Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Jai Prakash, the
learned Aga for the State, Sri Suresh Chandra Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant.

2.  The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in FIR bearing Case Crime No. 59 of 2018, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Kumarganj,
District Ayodhya.
3. Initially the applicant was granted interim anticipatory bail by means of an order dated 21.02.2023.
It has specifically recorded in the order dated 21.02.2023 that ?learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was appointed in the year 1973.
He retired in the year 2014 with unblemished record.
The F.I.R. has been lodged after a long delay in the year 2018."
4. It is specifically recorded in the order that the applicant has no criminal antecedent.

sentences.text: The informant has filed a counter affidavit, in paragraph 13 whereof, it has been stated that the statement of the applicant that he has no criminal history is false.

The applicant has already been convicted for Case Crime No. 255 of 2014, under Sections 352, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Kumarganj, District Faizabad (now Ayodhya) on the basis of his confession and after giving him benefit of Section 4 of the Probation of Offender Act, the applicant was released after payment of Rs.
1500/- as fine.
A copy of judgment and order dated 16.12.2020 convicting the applicant has been annexed with the counter affidavit.
6. Further, it has been stated in the counter affidavit that the applicant has not cooperated with the proceedings.
The Investigating Officer had submitted a charge sheet on 04.01.2019.
The trial court took cognizance of the case by means of order dated 02.09.2019 and summoned the applicant.
Upon non appearance of the applicant, the trial court issued bailable warrant and thereafter non bailable warrant was issued against the applicant.

Ultimately the Court had to issue a proclamation under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. by means of an order dated 21.11.2022.
7.

Counter affidavit was filed on 19.04.2023 after serving a copy of the same on the learned counsel for the applicant but no rejoinder affidavit has been filed even after expiry of three months since service of the copy of the counter affidavit.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that interim anticipatory bail was granted to the applicant after taking into consideration the specific assertion made by the applicant that he has no criminal history whereas the applicant is already convicted in offence under Sections 352, 504 & 506 IPC by means of an order dated 16.12.2020, I am of the view that the aforesaid conduct of the applicant disentitles him for grant of discretion of this Court by granting him anticipatory bail.
9. The anticipatory bail application is rejected.

10. However, in case the applicant files an application for grant of regular bail, the same shall be considered and decided in accordance with law, without being influenced by any observations made in this order.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Pradeep/-
